rules.statement: A Court is not bound to dismiss an action on the ground of a misjoinder of parties and causes of action.
rules.supporting_quote: I am however content to follow the decision in Kudhoos v. Joonoos 3 . [ 3 (1939) 41 N. L. R. 251 ] A Court should not be fettered by technical objections based on matters of procedure. Where the law permits it, the Judge should brush them aside by rectifying the mistake and by casting the offending party in costs.

meta.parties: Podihamy Et Al v. Seimon Appu
